scope: bounded public-source technical-preview vocabulary and crosswalk
freeze_rules: changes to listed normative artifacts require a successor candidate and digest update
unknown or unmapped terms fail closed
extensions remain namespaced and cannot redefine normative fields
the candidate is not a published ontology or operational authority
open_gates: persistent publication identifier and authority decision
nonclaims: Candidate freeze is repository evidence, not publication, domain-owner approval or stable-v1 promotion.
Agent-panel assessment cannot substitute for factual external participation or accountable authority.
